find: if (stop === 'window' || firstOff === -1) return { samples, stopReason: 'window', cutAtMs: null, endedAs };
replace: if (firstOff === -1) return { samples, stopReason: 'window', cutAtMs: null, endedAs };
killedBy: playingWindow: where a recording stops (issue #815) under `window`, keeps every sample and names the surface that left play
why: A `window` recipe records its whole window and lets the adapter refuse a round that ended inside it. Cutting silently would turn that refusal into a shorter clip nobody asked for.
